mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS above 5.0%) increases the cost of capital for corporations, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment (UNRATE rising by more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand (RSAFS above 350,000 million dollars) combined with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 5.0%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: demand-driven expansion with loose monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 350000 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion regime (INDPRO rising above 110.0), manufacturing output growth signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL rising by more than 0.5% in a month) signals monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST above 1,400,000 units) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 1,400,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO falling below 110.0) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime (PAYEMS rising above 138,000 thousand), job growth signals improving economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 138000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
